test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the FALSE statement.

options.text: Transpiration is the mechanism by which a plant eliminates surplus water.
Photosynthesis produces oxygen as a by-product.
Numerous waste products from plants are stored in centrioles.
Gum is an excretory product of plants.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Numerous waste products from plants are stored in centrioles.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Numerous waste products from plants are stored in centrioles** is a false statement.
 
• Centrioles are organelles involved in cell division and are not associated with storing waste products in plants.
 
• Waste products in plants are typically stored in vacuoles, resins, gums, or excreted through processes like transpiration.
 
• Transpiration is the mechanism by which a plant eliminates surplus water.
 
• **Photosynthesis **produces **oxygen as a by-product**.
 
• **Gum **is an **excretory product of plants**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Centrioles** are cylindrical structures found in animal cells and some lower plant forms, playing a key role in cell division.
 
• In higher plants, cell division occurs without centrioles.
 
• Plant cells typically store waste products in the central vacuole or secrete them into the surrounding environment.
